item.title: I love the work of the ArchWiki maintainers
item.description:
📝 For this year's "I love Free Software Day" I would like to thank the maintainers of Free Software documentation, and here especially the maintainers of the ArchWiki. Maintainers in general, and maintainers of documentation most of the time get way too little recognition for their contributions to software freedom. Myself, Arch Project Leader Levente, ArchWiki maintainer Ferdinand (Alad), and FSFE's vice president Heiki at FOSDEM 2026 after I handed them over some hacker chocolate.
🔗 Read more: https://k7r.eu/i-love-the-work-of-the-archwiki-maintainers/
